en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view over the Danube River in Budapest, showing the Széchenyi Chain Bridge with early automobiles and carriages crossing. The foreground features large riverside buildings, and across the river is the Pest side with a dense row of classical buildings. A large domed church, identifiable as St. Stephen's Basilica, rises prominently in the background. Text is printed in red at the bottom margin in Hungarian and German.
